approaches.title: Sorted triple enumeration
approaches.summary: Sort the numbers, then enumerate distinct triples with three nested loops. Stop scanning the innermost loop once its sum exceeds the target and track the closest sum.

revisions.shortChangeSummary: Sorts the input and checks triples with three nested loops, skipping duplicate values and stopping the innermost scan when the sum exceeds the target.

approaches.title: Sorted two-pointer search
approaches.summary: Sort the numbers, fix each first element, and use two pointers to search the remaining range. Move a pointer according to whether the current sum is below or above the target, with bounds-based short circuits.

revisions.commitComment: same strat as 3sum, with short circuit
revisions.rawCommitSubject: rust 16: same strat as 3sum, with short circuit
revisions.shortChangeSummary: Replaces triple enumeration with a two-pointer search for each fixed element, adding bounds-based short circuits and an exact-target early return.
